info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Customer By Asset Id-spec
info.description: The Customer Asset Retrieval API allows developers to retrieve detailed information about a customer based on their unique asset ID. This endpoint is essential for applications that need to access customer-related data tied to specific assets. Typical consumers include financial institutions and asset management platforms that support customer inquiries. By utilizing this API, systems can efficiently provide users with the necessary customer data, enhancing service delivery and user experience.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific asset for a customer.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details about a specific asset associated with a given customer. You can use this to view asset information, such as its status, value, and other attributes relevant to the customer.

requestBody.description: A request to retrieve the details of a specific asset associated with a customer. The request must contain the appropriate schema as defined in the OpenAPI specifications.
